name: Ambiguity Embiggener
phrases: At the start of each player's turn, that player chooses a number for X
Each player puts X cards from their hand on the bottom of their deck
notes: Already fans out with forEachPlayer inside a chooserSelectsNumber (chooser activePlayer); each player's pass rebinds controller. Just keep forEachPlayer iterating all N seats in turn order.

name: Anesthetizing Opulence
phrases: An opponent draws a card.
notes: Single resolving-block opponent; the bound opponent draws.

name: Arcanology Recruitment Officer
phrases: pick a character an opponent controls
notes: Pick restricted to the block's bound opponent's characters; the COVERT grant lasts until the controller's next turn start, unaffected by seat count.

name: Ass
phrases: an opponent picks a character they control and own if they can
an opponent takes control of this card
notes: Two separate triggered abilities = two blocks, each binds its own opponent (they may differ in 3+ players); each reads fine as 'an opponent'.

name: Auction House
phrases: players take turns bidding on the character (starting with the active player)
Whichever player makes the winning bid
Shuffle all other revealed cards into their owners's deck
notes: auctionForCard is a two-party construct today; with 3+ players every living player bids in seat order starting with the active player (not controller + bound opponent), unspent bids/shuffles apply to all. Engine-side change, no data change expected.

name: Barbaric Rifleman
phrases: inflict 1 damage to an opponent's faction
notes: Bound opponent's faction.

name: Blow Up
phrases: That item's controller's faction loses 3 influence.
notes: modifyInfluence uses player:"opponent" but the text means the destroyed item's controller (could be the caster, or a non-bound opponent). Re-encode as player {type:"controllerOf", target selected it}, captured before the destroy.

name: Braggadocian Aide
phrases: At the start of each opponent's turn
notes: Trigger condition eventPlayerIs opponent must match any opponent; the effect only touches the controller's own resources, so no binding needed.

name: Clockman Pickpocket
phrases: While an opponent controls an item, this card cannot be blocked by that player.
that faction's controller picks an item they control if they can
notes: (1) Static cannotBeBlocked keys off 'an opponent controls an item' (sum across all opponents); it should test the defending player's items only (the blocker, D7). (2) steal chooser/selector use opponent; should be controllerOf(eventCard) (the damaged faction's controller), which may differ from the bound opponent.

name: Counter Attack
phrases: Deploy this only during an opponent's turn
Attack that player.
notes: Condition not-isActivePlayer(controller) = any opponent's turn; initiateAttack target is activePlayer, so 'that player' is derived, not bound. Ensure binding never prompts or diverges from the active player here.

name: Cute Cutpurse
phrases: While an opponent controls an item, this card cannot be blocked by that player.
pick an item that faction's controller controls
notes: Same as Clockman Pickpocket: unblock condition should test the defending player's items; smash selector controller:opponent should be controllerOf(eventCard), the damaged faction's controller.

name: Deadly Striker
phrases: an opponent's faction loses 4 influence
notes: Bound opponent loses 4.

name: Deceptive Muddler
phrases: that faction's controller puts a card from their hand on the top of their deck
notes: Chooser is already controllerOf(eventCard) but the selector is owner:opponent (bound opponent's hand). Selector should be the chooser's own hand (owner self relative to chooser) / the damaged faction's controller, which may not be the bound opponent.

name: Dethmürderblüdgeon, the Craghammer
phrases: When the attached character is blocked, an opponent's faction loses 2 influence.
notes: Text says 'an opponent'; bound opponent loses 2 (the blocker's controller would be a nicer choice but is not required).

name: Discommodiousness
phrases: An opponent reveals their hand.
That player draws X cards
notes: Whole effect resolves against one bound opponent.

For the rest of the game, you may deploy tactics voided by this card
notes: Single bound opponent; voided cards are tracked by voidedBySource, no opponent persistence needed.

name: Eldridge Gosche
phrases: Look at an opponent's hand and choose a card in it. That player discards that card.
notes: Disrupt binds one opponent per activation.

name: Embezzling Bookkeeper
phrases: an opponent draws a card

Otherwise, destroy all of that opponent's characters.
notes: Wrap the oppHad bind + both `if` blocks in a forEachPlayer limited to opponents (needs an 'each opponent' / exclude-controller variant); inside, controller/owner rebind so selectors become self and the chooser is the iterated opponent. Keep the final 'draw a card' outside the fan-out.

name: Epiphany Ball
phrases: An opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Bound opponent takes control.

name: Exploding Sock Puppet!

notes: noResponse must suppress every other player's priority in the rotation (D6), not just one; no data change.

name: Fool's Gold

notes: Activation-time pick of an item any opponent controls; derive the bound opponent from the picked item's controller (or prompt first) so pick and takeControl agree.

Inflict 6 damage to all factions.
notes: Already fans out with forEachPlayer for hand/discard/deck removal and forEach over all factions; works for N players.

name: Hired Goons

when that opponent deploys a card
terminate the opponent's card

It must be bound to the opponent searched by the tactic: store chosenOpponentId (on the tactic/voided card) and test eventPlayerIs that player; otherwise another opponent playing a same-named card triggers it.

name: Imperial Thaumaturge
phrases: An opponent discards a card.

name: Inside Information
phrases: An opponent takes control of this card.
notes: Bound opponent.

greater than or equal to the numeric cost of all opponent's
notes: Replacement effect removes only controller's and one opponent's top card. Fan out removal with forEachPlayer, record each player's cost, and compare myCost >= max(cost of every other player's card) instead of a single oppCost.

That player's choses an opponent to discard a card.

Collapse into one trigger for any drawing player, resolved as that player (controller := event player) with that player binding their own opponent for the 0-token discard, and eventPlayerIs matching any seat.

If that player's faction has 15 influence or less
